iris_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "sepal_length": [5.1, 4.9, 4.7, 5.0, 5.4,
                     7.0, 6.4, 6.9, 5.5, 6.5,
                     6.3, 5.8, 7.1, 6.5, 7.6],

    "species": ["setosa"] * 5 + ["versicolor"] * 5 + ["virginica"] * 5,
})

print(iris_df.groupby("species")["sepal_length"].median())

try:
    import os
    os.environ.setdefault("MPLCONFIGDIR", "/tmp/mplconfig")
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use("Agg")

    import seaborn as sns

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    ax.set_title("Sepal length by species")
    plt.close(fig)
except Exception as exc:
    print("plot skipped:", type(exc).__name__)
